Name: Pickaxe Area Extended
Author: KringleKiller
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Allows adjsutable hit area for the pickaxe with area config via GMCM[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Install via Vortex or unzip folder into Stardew Valley\Content\Mods[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds configurable hit area to pickaxe[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI[/color][/size]

Downloads.Description: Small update to add configurable hotkey. Must have tool selected. hotkey cycles through hit area options with each press.

Manifest.Name: Pickaxe Area
Manifest.Description: Choose a 1x1, 3x3, 5x5, or 7x7 pickaxe area centered on the target tile. Includes Generic Mod Config Menu support.
